scope: post-hoc saved-path offline counterfactual; no navigation, inference, render, Graph solve
SP: Import Phase18D speed profile unchanged; exact original execution calculation; extend to 8s. No new terminal speed constraint at final path endpoint.

S.frequency: once at initial departure; scan stored path point order, no fabricated tangent/yaw

P.merge_scope: turn detection only; retain native path vertices in each leg
P.incoming_leg: same SP limits and two passes, terminal speed limit zero; remove .05 execution floor on stopping leg

SRG.rotation: bounded braking to actual v=0 first; 9Hz command abs(w)=.4 except final command clipped to remaining angle/control_dt; 72Hz integration; no teleport
SRG.after_pivot: new PP leg, reset geometric progress, resume SP from zero with the same acceleration cap

evaluation.oracle: existing exact/swept box and corridor evaluator; circular radius .09m; never input to controller
evaluation.termination: endpoint or 8s; oracle overlap never terminates command generation
evaluation.unsafe_completion: recorded as kinematic completion only, separately safe_completion false
evaluation.time_pairs: both completed; also separately both completed without overlap; no missing-time imputation
evaluation.completion_average_speed: full fixed path arclength / elapsed completion time; actual travelled distance/time separately

datasets.D1: Phase18D SLW common85 plus all available paths; RAW/FRESHEST-SAFE, HERMITE, stored accepted CLR
datasets.D2: Phase18D CL common166 plus all available paths; same three paths
datasets.D4: all755 selected Phase19R development repairs, descriptive only
datasets.unavailable: retain exclusion reason; do not fabricate a CLR path or re-solve

decision.safety: D3 overlap fraction <=.01 AND for each D1 path type SRG overlaps <= SP, checked in BOTH original common and method-available scopes
decision.timing: D2 original common166 events, pooled three path types; median SRG/SP among paired completions <=1.10

checks: five unit tests; every SP path prefix compared with saved <=1.5s metrics; initial B and native observation frame preserved; bounds verified on every command
analysis_defaults: Clarification offered before execution; no reply by freeze. Oracle-passive full-horizon evaluation and common/available reporting disclosed before data rollouts.
